prompt: Build a CLI data processing tool supporting CSV/JSON/YAML read/write with composable transforms (filter, sort, rename, computed columns).

assertions.name: reader_abstraction
assertions.description: Input reading behind a trait so new formats are just new impls

assertions.name: transform_abstraction
assertions.description: Each transform is a separate type implementing a common trait, NOT enum branches

assertions.name: pipeline_composition
assertions.description: Transforms composed into Vec<Box<dyn Transform>> or similar extensible pipeline

assertions.name: format_agnostic_core
assertions.description: Core model decoupled from file formats — reading/writing at boundaries
